Section: Nimbus Labs Backup and Disaster Recovery Plan > Recovery objectives

Recovery Point Objective (RPO): 1 hour. At most one hour of data can be lost.Recovery Time Objective (RTO): 4 hours. Service is restored within four hours of a declared disaster.

Section: Nimbus Labs Backup and Disaster Recovery Plan > Backups

Automated daily snapshots of the production database.Snapshots are retained for 35 days.Continuous transaction-log shipping supports the one-hour RPO.All backups are encrypted with AES-256.

Section: Nimbus Labs Backup and Disaster Recovery Plan > Responsibilities

The Engineering Manager owns the plan. The on-call engineer declares a disaster and the founder is informed within 30 minutes.

Section: Nimbus Labs Backup and Disaster Recovery Plan > Disaster recovery site

Production runs in AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1). A cross-region replica is maintained in Singapore (ap-southeast-1) and can be promoted to primary during a regional failure.

Section: Nimbus Labs Backup and Disaster Recovery Plan > Note on data location

Because the disaster recovery replica is in Singapore, customers who need all copies of their data kept in India should discuss this with Nimbus Labs before signing.

Section: Nimbus Labs Backup and Disaster Recovery Plan > Testing

Restores are tested every quarter. The most recent restore test was on 12 September 2026 and was completed in 2 hours 40 minutes, within the 4-hour RTO. Results are reviewed by the Engineering Manager and filed in the evidence folder.

Section: Nimbus Labs Privacy Note > Data location

Customer data is stored in India by default (AWS Mumbai). Disaster recovery copies are held in Singapore, as described in the backup plan.
